relations.reading: Bounded repair in xSeil suggests a way to limit collateral change when an industrial delivery plan is disrupted.

relations.title: Phylons Liquidity Orquestration
relations.reading: A shared-resource intent layer could be tested for industrial deployment without importing financial allocation rules unchanged.

relations.title: When the Controls Work but the System Fails
relations.reading: Industrial delivery is complete only when the composed chain supports customer production readiness; passing each local control does not establish that end-to-end outcome.
